excerpt: In this horror anthology, three young drug dealers visit an eccentric funeral director to collect a lost stash, but first he wants to introduce four of his clients and explain how each one arrived.
title: Tales from the Hood

excerpt: A bullied metalhead plays his dead idol’s final album backward, and the voice on the record offers to help him get even.
title: Trick or Treat

excerpt: Cardinal Richelieu’s agents conspire with sexually repressed abbess Vanessa Redgrave to brand popular but womanizing priest Oliver Reed as in league with the devil.
title: The Devils

excerpt: Military scientists clone Ellen Ripley from a blood sample to harvest the alien queen she was carrying, but the new Ripley isn’t entirely human, which comes in handy when the aliens break loose.
title: Alien: Resurrection

excerpt: An American music student researching a late composer falls for his son at the family’s French estate, learns she is the image of the girl he lost, and begins to suspect she was invited for sinister reasons.
title: Crescendo
